products.usage: Apply as mulch and ground cover to suppress weed growth and retain moisture. During cold months Bark can protect plants and shrubs by controlling soil temperature.

products.name: Fine Dark Bark

products.usage: Apply as a mulch and ground cover to suppress weed growth and retain moisture. During cold months Bark can protect plants and shrubs by controlling soil temperature.

products.name: Medium Nugget Bark
products.description: Bark screened to approximately 1"-2" specification. More textured and free of fine particles. Provides a longer lasting results as it does not decompose as fast as the fine or medium barks.
products.usage: Often used for ground cover around plants and other landscaping areas you want to suppress weed growth.

products.name: Medium Bark

products.name: Sawdust (Alder)

products.usage: Pet/stall bedding.

products.name: Hog Fuel
products.description: Up to 6" wood shreds consisting of a mixture of inner wood and bark. Generally made from stumps & large tree-clearing projects.
products.usage: Used in design of composting garden beds (Huegel's), layered under other mulches for adding organics to existing soils.

products.name: #4 to Dust
products.description: 1/4" crushed rock with fines. Sometimes known as paver base. Compacts tight and smooth.
products.usage: Often used under stepping stones, pavers and flagstone. Great for walkways and dog runs. Can be used to fill potholes.

products.name: 1 1/4" Clean — Black
products.description: 1 1/4" clean crushed aggregate without fines. Rock 1" to 1 1/4" in size. Will not pack but will stay in place better than a round rock. Color ranges from dark gray when dry to almost black when wet.
products.usage: Often used as a top course for muddy driveways or parking areas. Can be used for pavement sub-base, foundation material, draining applications, behind retaining wall or decorative landscape.

products.name: 1 1/2" Drain Rock
products.description: 1 1/2" smooth round washed rock. Screened material that is uniform in size. Will not pack.
products.usage: Often used as pipe bedding, French drains and decorative landscape. Not for driveways or parking areas.

products.name: 1 1/4" Clean — Grey
products.description: 1 1/4" clean crushed aggregate without fines. Light grey fractured rock in 1" to 1 1/4" in size. Will not pack but will stay in place better than a round rock.
products.usage: Often used as a top course for muddy driveways or parking areas. Can be used for pavement sub-base, foundation material, draining applications, behind retaining wall or decorative landscape.

products.name: 1 1/4" Minus — Grey
products.description: 1 1/4" crushed rock with fines. Light grey aggregate that has been crushed. Fines work as a binder for compaction. Does not pack as tight as 5/8" Minus.
products.usage: Better for softer area than 5/8" Minus. Can be used as a pavement sub-base or road base. Typically used for commercial driveways or parking spaces for big trucks and RV's.

products.name: 3" × 10" Castle Rock
products.description: Please note that this rock is unwashed and will contain a small amount of sand and dirt fines.
products.usage: Often used for hardscapes, ground cover, landscape trim, drainage and erosion control. Helps suppress weeds and unwanted growth.

products.name: 3/4" Clean — Black
products.description: 3/4" clean crushed aggregate without fines. Fractured rock ranging in color from dark gray while dry and near black while wet. Will not pack.
products.usage: Often used as a top course on driveways and pathways. Better than 3/4" minus for a muddy area. Good for behind retaining walls.

products.name: 3/4" × 3" Castle Rock
products.description: Please note that this rock is unwashed and will contain a small amount of sand and dirt fines.
products.usage: Often used for landscaping around plants and garden areas as well as drainage to prevent ground erosion. Can also be used in pipe bedding and french drains.

products.name: 3/8" Pea Gravel
products.description: 3/8" smooth round washed rock. Screened material that is uniform in size. Will not pack.
products.usage: Often used as an ingredient in concrete, pipe bedding, French drains and decorative landscape. Good for play areas. Not for driveways or parking areas.

products.name: 5/8" Minus — Gray
products.description: 5/8" crushed rock with fines. Light grey aggregate that has been crushed. Fines work as a binder for compaction. Packs down tightly and holds in place very well.
products.usage: Often used as a base for residential driveways. Commonly used in walkways or parking areas. Great for base material under flagstone, retaining walls or concrete. Can be used to fill potholes.

products.name: 7/8" Drain Rock
products.description: 7/8" smooth round washed rock. Screened material that is uniform in size. Will not pack.
products.usage: Often used as an ingredient in concrete, pipe bedding, French drains and decorative landscape. Not for driveways or parking areas.

products.name: Utility Sand
products.description: An unwashed sand that is coarse in texture and brownish-gray in color.
products.usage: Used to stabilize pavers, stepping stones and flagstone. Can be used as pipe bedding or an ingredient in concrete. Helps with drainage in soil. Not recommended for sand boxes due to being unwashed and dusty.

products.name: 1 1/4" Minus — Black
products.description: 1 1/4" crushed rock with fines. Light grey aggregate that has been crushed. Fines work as a binder for compaction. Does not pack as tight as 5/8" Minus.
products.usage: Better for softer area than 5/8" Minus. Can be used as a pavement sub-base or road base. Typically used for commercial driveways or parking spaces for big trucks and RV's.

products.name: 5/8" Minus — Black
products.description: 5/8" crushed rock with fines. Light grey aggregate that has been crushed. Fines work as a binder for compaction. Packs down tightly and holds in place very well.
products.usage: Often used as a base for residential driveways. Commonly used in walkways or parking areas. Great for base material under flagstone, retaining walls or concrete. Can be used to fill potholes.

products.name: Pumice
products.description: Pumice is a type of extrusive volcanic rock formed from gas bubbles causing it to be a very light and porous rock filled with bubbles of gas.
products.usage: Used to make lightweight construction materials such as concrete block, insulation, roofing and landscaping. It is also used in many potting soils to improve drainage and oxygen to get to the root zones of your plants.

products.name: Greens Grade Sand
products.description: Top dressing sand used to level and top dress lawns.
products.usage: Top dress and level lawns.

products.name: 3-Way Topsoil
products.description: Screened Sandy Loam Soil, Sand, Compost
products.usage: Often used to plant grass seed or lay SOD. Can be used to raise beds. All-around planting mix for lawns, filling in low spots, and all-around general use.

products.name: Premium Garden Blend
products.description: Combination of 3-Way Topsoil, Coarse Sand, Greens Compost and Moo Magic.
products.usage: Walrath's signature planting blend. Plant ready mix for flowers, trees, shrubs and vegetables. Plants get microbials from both types of compost.

products.name: Turf Booster
products.description: A mix of volcanic sand, coarse-washed sand, and Organic Super Doo.
products.usage: Topdressing and new lawns. This product is a mix of fine sand (St. Helens minerals), coarse washed sand, and composts.

products.name: House Blend Potting Soil
products.description: An exclusive mix of organic and natural ingredients for beautiful and bountiful containers.
products.usage: Great for all of your favorite outdoor container plants including vegetables, fruits, and flowers. Great for refreshing existing containers as well.

products.name: Compost
products.description: A dark fine material made from composted yard waste. A locally produced registered Organic (WSDA Organic Food program) green-waste compost. Green waste compost is manufactured under rigorous guidelines of Dept. Of Ecology. Compost is produced using state of the art technology which monitors for oxygen and temperature throughout the active composting time frame. Under strict guidelines, compost is tested and reported back to local permitting agencies. Current test results available from the permitting agencies upon request at any time.
products.usage: Enriches soil for vegetable gardens & flower beds, helping retain moisture and suppress plant diseases and pests. Reduces the need for chemical fertilizers. Encourages the production of beneficial bacteria and fungi that break down organic matter to create humus, a rich nutrient-filled material. Can be used as mulch top dressing if desired. Disclaimer: Compost is a recycled product used in many of our soil mixes. Even with quality control standards, recycled products may contain a small percentage of foreign materials such as plastic, metal, and glass. Please use recycled materials in appropriate applications. Handle with care. Glove use is recommended.

products.name: Moo Magic
products.description: Blend of greens Compost and washed dairy manure. Provides a wide range of beneficial microorganisms
products.usage: Amend existing soils for vegetable and flower beds. Usage as mulch on beds or fertilize your lawn.

products.name: Mushroom Compost
products.description: Composted (bedding/growing media) recycled/spent growing media: combination of: peat moss, straw, gypsum mixed with greens compost, brewer yeast & apple and grape pomace.
products.usage: Great for an added boost to all your gardening needs. It is a great source of microbials and nutrients. It can be mixed in with current soil or used as a compost/mulch. *due to the dark color of the product, it can aid in heat and sun rays during hotter months and cause burns to plants such as grasses.
